title: 第465章 给皇后一个选择第464章 世界的秘密
slug: 我的灵根等级怎么是负的
content_zh:
格雷维斯思考了一会儿女皇的话。“我确信，人类一达到元婴境界，肯定不会得到那种东西。父亲说过，人类达到元婴境界后会得到某种秘密武器，但这肯定不是。”
格雷维斯眯起眼睛望着地平线。“我想，这又是上天为了让野兽保持足够强大的力量，以便它们能够磨练自身力量的手段之一。野兽或许无法获得人类拥有的这种秘密武器，所以上天才会赋予野兽法则。”
“另外，对于那些从未接触过法则的野兽来说，理解法则或许能给它们提供理解更多法则所需的开端。我确信天堂教导的法则与我吸收惩罚雷电时不同。否则，这毫无意义。”格雷维斯心想。
然后，格雷维斯再次看向女皇。“我还有一个问题。”
“说吧，”女皇说道。她其实并不介意和格雷维斯谈谈。毕竟，比赛的事情已经过去了，现在她又有大把的空闲时间了。
“有没有野兽一成为王就立刻死亡的情况？”格雷维斯问道。
皇后瞪大了眼睛。“你怎么知道的？”她问道。
格雷维斯已经收起了铠甲，摸着下巴若有所思。“原来如此。我早就料到了。”
“这是一把双刃剑，”格雷维斯心想。“惩戒雷律基本上是雷电本身赋予我的，而非上天。父亲说过，这可能会让我更难理解我的第一条法则，而这条法则已经被证明是正确的。如果没有父亲的指导，以及与金龙战斗时那股难以言喻的压力，我根本不可能理解关于材料的法则。”
“我相信上天不会让野兽遭受同样的劣势。毕竟，上天希望所有野兽都变得强大。因此，上天必须将野兽的心智传送到某种境界，让它们能够全神贯注于最适合自己的法则。”
格雷维斯眯起眼睛。“然而，并非所有野兽都能领悟法则。这意味着有些野兽根本无法离开这个空间。以我所了解的上天行事，它不会允许这种低等野兽生存。”
“嘿，”女皇有些恼火地说，“我问你怎么知道的。”尽管她问了他一个问题，但她已经观察格雷维斯望向地平线有一会儿了。
女皇的话把格雷维斯从沉思中拉了回来，他回头看着她。“我当时陷入了沉思。我不太清楚具体是怎么回事，但我脑子里觉得挺有道理的。”格雷维斯回答道。
皇后皱起眉头。“这怎么可能？如果你不知道这件事，就没办法根据上下文推断出这样的事情。那么，你是怎么知道的？”她又问。
格雷维斯叹了口气。“我有很多秘密，我不想随便告诉任何人。我很抱歉，”格雷维斯说。
皇后越发恼火了。“我一直耐心地回答你的问题，你却说不能回答我的问题？”她恼怒地问道。
格雷维斯又叹了口气。“这很复杂，”他回答道。“由于我的背景，我对这个世界的运作方式了解很多，但这些知识非常宝贵。我可以肯定地告诉你，我所知道的关于这个世界的事情，是这世上其他野兽都不知道的。”
如果其他野兽对女皇说这些话，她肯定会嗤之以鼻。然而，格雷维斯的力量和行为举止却异常怪异，非同寻常。他展现出了令人难以置信的力量。
“你想用这些秘密换什么？”女皇问道。她原本想威胁格拉维斯，但就她所见，格拉维斯似乎不像是那种容易被威胁的野兽。于是，她决定用交易来交换。
格雷维斯看着女皇，眼神闪闪发亮。“有件事困扰我很久了，如果你能接受这个条件，我会尽可能多地告诉你我的秘密。”

女皇的眉头又皱了起来。“你能分享多少就分享多少？有我在，谁能强迫你保守秘密？你自己也说过，你不属于任何更强大的帝国。”
格雷维斯脸上露出复杂的表情。“很遗憾，这也是我的秘密。我只能告诉你，我一次都没骗过你。”他说。
皇后听后顿时恼火不已。格雷维斯怎么突然变得这么神秘了？更何况，她还记得他还是个领主。为什么感觉自己是在跟一个地位平等的人说话，而不是跟一个比她弱小得多的人说话？这整个场景让她感觉很不真实。
几秒钟后，女皇再次叹了口气。她决定让步。向某个领主让步让她感觉怪怪的，但潜在的好处或许值得失去。如果格雷维斯的秘密是胡扯，她以后还可以一怒之下杀了他。
“好的，你的情况怎么样？”她问道。
“就是这个！”格雷维斯满怀动力地想。
“你可能已经注意到我与其他野兽非常不同，”格雷维斯说道。
皇后冷笑一声，这很明显。
“其中一个不同之处就是我与生活伴侣和后代的关系，”格雷维斯说。
皇后饶有兴趣地挑了挑眉，却没有说话。
“对我来说，孩子或许比我的权力之路更重要。我现在不想生孩子，因为那样我会被迫和他们建立情感联系。只要他们还在，我就无法再轻松地继续我的事业。”
“所以，”格雷维斯叹了口气说，“我活着的时候不想有任何后代。这就是我的现状。”
content_en:
Graves thought about the Queen's words for a moment. "I am sure that humans will not get that kind of thing once they reach the Nascent Soul realm. My father said that humans will get some kind of secret weapon after they reach the Nascent Soul realm, but this is definitely not it."
Graves squinted at the horizon. "I think this is another way for God to keep the beasts strong enough so that they can hone their own strength. The beasts may not be able to obtain the secret weapons possessed by humans, so God will give the beasts laws."
"Also, for those beasts who have never been exposed to the Laws, understanding the Laws may give them the beginning they need to understand more Laws. I am sure that the Laws taught in Heaven are different from when I absorbed the Punishment Thunder. Otherwise, it is meaningless." Graves thought to himself.
Then, Graves looked at the Queen again. "I have one more question."
"Speak," said the Queen. She actually didn't mind talking to Graves. After all, the competition was over, and now she had a lot of free time.
"Is there any situation where the beast dies as soon as it becomes king?" Graves asked.
The queen's eyes widened. "How did you know?" she asked.
Graves had put away his armor and touched his chin thoughtfully. "I see. I had expected it."
"It's a double-edged sword," Graves thought to himself. "The Thunder Law of Punishment was basically given to me by the lightning itself, not God. My father said that this might make it more difficult for me to understand my first law, and this law has been proven to be correct. Without my father's guidance and the indescribable pressure when fighting the golden dragon, it would be impossible for me to understand the law about materials."
"I believe that God will not let the beasts suffer the same disadvantage. After all, God wants all beasts to become powerful. Therefore, God must send the minds of the beasts to a certain state so that they can concentrate on the laws that are most suitable for them."
Graves narrowed his eyes. "However, not all beasts understand the Law. This means that some beasts simply cannot leave this space. From what I understand of God's actions, it will not allow such lowly beasts to survive."
"Hey," the Queen said with some annoyance, "I asked you how you knew." Although she asked him a question, she had been watching Graves look towards the horizon for a while.
The Queen's words brought Graves out of his thoughts, and he looked back at her. "I was lost in thought. I don't know exactly what happened, but it made sense in my mind," Graves replied.
The queen frowned. "How is this possible? If you don't know about this, there is no way to infer such a thing from the context. So, how do you know?" she asked again.
Graves sighed. "I have a lot of secrets that I don't want to tell just anyone. I'm sorry," Graves said.
The queen became more and more annoyed. "I have been patiently answering your questions, but you said you can't answer mine?" she asked angrily.
Graves sighed again. "It's complicated," he replied. "I know a lot about how the world works because of my background, but that knowledge is incredibly valuable. I can tell you for certain that I know things about the world that no other beast in the world knows."
If any other beast had said these words to the Queen, she would have scoffed. However, Graves' powers and mannerisms are strange and unusual. He showed incredible strength.
"What do you want to exchange these secrets for?" the Queen asked. She originally wanted to threaten Gravis, but from what she saw, Gravis didn't seem like the kind of beast that could be easily threatened. So, she decided to trade.
Graves looked at the Queen,Eyes sparkling. "There is something that has been bothering me for a long time. If you can accept this condition, I will tell you as many of my secrets as possible."
The Queen's brows wrinkled again. "You can share as much as you can? With me here, who can force you to keep secrets? You yourself have said that you do not belong to any more powerful empire."
Graves had a complicated expression on his face. "Unfortunately, this is also my secret. I can only tell you that I have never lied to you once." He said.
The queen became very angry after hearing this. Why did Graves suddenly become so mysterious? What's more, she still remembers that he was still a lord. Why does it feel like she is talking to someone of equal status instead of someone much weaker than her? This whole scene felt unreal to her.
After a few seconds, the Queen sighed again. She decided to give in. It felt strange to her to give in to a certain lord, but the potential benefits might be worth the loss. If Graves' secret was bullshit, she could kill him in a rage later.
"Okay, how are you doing?" she asked.
"This is it!" Graves thought with motivation.
"You may have noticed that I am very different from other beasts," Graves said.
The Queen sneered, it was obvious.
“One of the differences is my relationship with my life partner and offspring,” Graves said.
The queen raised her eyebrows with interest, but said nothing.
"Children are probably more important to me than my path to power. I don't want to have children right now because then I would be forced to have an emotional connection with them. I wouldn't be able to easily continue my career as long as they are around."
"So," Graves sighed, "I don't want to have any descendants while I'm alive. This is where I am."
